description.text: A special Sword & Shield set released on 19 February 2021 and sold only in special collections, following Hidden Fates with a Shiny Pokémon theme. Its 195 cards are a main set of 72 with one secret rare and a Shiny Vault of 122 cards numbered SV1 to SV122; in all it has more than 100 Shiny Pokémon and more than 30 Pokémon V and VMAX. Its best-known card is the Shiny Charizard VMAX, Charizard in its Gigantamax form, in the Shiny Vault.
